landmarks.notes: This is a silhouette curvature feature rather than a persistent material point. HSI horizontal line artifact nearby; not a precise calibration point.

landmarks.feature: Distal main-midrib region at a lateral vein junction after the central fork
landmarks.notes: Veins are repetitive and low contrast; candidate requires patch-level confirmation. Deliberately outside known central heldout locations.

landmarks.feature: Next distal main-midrib/lateral-vein junction toward the terminal margin
landmarks.notes: Branch-order match tentative because RGB foreshortening merges fine veins; candidate, not certified landmark.

selection: Manual visual comparison of original RGB and FX10 pseudocolour; no manual dimension fitting, no known central control fitted.
judgment: Same leaf topology is plausible. HSI and RGB silhouettes and vein angles differ substantially with viewpoint/foreshortening and possibly leaf deformation. These images alone do not distinguish viewpoint effects from nonrigid movement. A single global affine or planar mapping cannot be assumed. Only tip and basal notch have moderately strong anatomical uniqueness; four additional broad-spatial candidates carry substantial uncertainty.
rejected: G8 descriptor correspondence maps HSI distal tip to RGB lateral margin; do not use as training. Repeated appearance matches near the same vein fork do not establish full-leaf coverage.
recommendation: Use these for initialization and independent patch review, not as ground truth. Keep both existing central feature controls held out. Report sensitivity to omitting each low-confidence boundary/vein candidate; do not publish dense measured assignments solely from this hand fit.
